{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Fire}}
[[File:Fire_at_Noas.png|thumb|250px|Fire burning in [[Noa Briqualon]]'s stove]]
{{Quote|The Force is not fire. It cannot be passed from one user's lit torch to another's, and another's until an entire hemisphere is illuminated with a blaze of a million lights.|From the writings of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]|<ref name="BoSSotDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Fire''' was the visible, highly exothermic reaction between combustible fuel and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] at extremely high temperatures. It usually appeared as orange or yellow glowing 'tongues' of erratically rising gas, but could be other [[Color/Legends|colors]] depending on the chemical being burned and the completeness of the combustion. While its intense heat could cause physical damage, fire was an important part of many cultures and religions from ancient to modern times.

==Practical uses==
{{Quote|Thank you for building the fire.|[[Cindel Towani]] to [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]]|<ref name="Ewoks: The Battle for Endor">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>}}
[[File:IG88Flamethrower-ChampionsOfTheForce.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] sets his victim on fire with a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]].]]
In archaic cultures, fire was often maintained for heating and cooking. Specific structures called [[fireplace]]s were often found in old houses and [[Castle/Legends|castles]] like [[Château Malreaux]], but also in more modern housings. When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was imprisoned on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], her room was equipped with a fireplace.<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], who had managed to balance nature and technology in their culture, still used fireplaces at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

When establishing a campsite, a fire (then known as campfire) was often lit for warmth and psychological sense of security. In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], before their [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|final battle]], the Sith established a camp on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] with many cooking fires around the tents.<ref name="DBPOD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> Similarly, when he first came to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] saw a campfire constructed by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. Later on Dathomir, Han Solo used his blaster to light a small campfire when the group he was travelling with found a location to rest and make camp for the night.<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

Besides domestic uses, fire was also used in deliberately harmful ways. A vast array of weapons known as [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] projected streams of burning gas or flammable liquid. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a squad of [[Flame trooper/Legends|specialized]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were equipped with massive [[BT X-42 flamethrower]]s as well as other incendiary weapons.<ref name="CWNBV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Years later, under the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Incinerator stormtrooper/Legends|Incinerator stormtroopers]] would burn their enemies to death.<ref name="TFUGG">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] who lived on the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] made use of fire cannon to destroy the [[Warrick family hut|hut]] of the [[Warrick family/Legends|Warrick]], a family of peaceful [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="BFE">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> Among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the arcane and deadly [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] known as [[Convection]] also allowed its user to modify the heat of their own skin and set their opponent's robes on fire through direct contact.<ref name="BoSSotDS" /> Another fire based Force Power, while rare, was [[pyrokinesis]] which was used by both Sith and Jedi.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref><ref name="Children of the Jedi novel">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

Fire was also often used as a means to destroy dead bodies through a process known as [[Cremation/Legends|cremation]], which was often performed at funerals. Individuals whose bodies were cremated with fire included [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]],<ref name="ZamWesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref> [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]],<ref name="The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> and a group of Jawas who were killed by Imperial Stormtroopers on Tatooine.<ref name="Episode IV: A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Cultural roles==
[[File:Kashyyyk_landscape.png|thumb|Two [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] light a campfire on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].]]
In the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] culture, fire was often used to symbolize the vivid hate or passion. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Kopecz]] once used fire as a symbol for the power of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], burning like anger with the heat of passion and emotion.<ref name="DBPOD" /> In other cases, fire was considered a purifying substance. [[Rajivari]]'s apprentices were known to be flawed, but once they "walked the fire", they were considered to be pure. Sacrificing oneself to the flames was considered a demonstration of resolve and strength.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> On the contrary, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] considered fire to be an abomination.<ref name="Edge of Victory I: Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>

Sometimes, large campfires known as "bonfires" would be built as part of a celebration. The [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphids]] from [[Toola/Legends|Toola]] used to roast the remains of [[snow demon]]s, and the young ones danced around them while the elders played the claw harps.<ref name="COPL" />
